home.heroSubtitle: Discover an ancient walled city of 82 mosques, warm hospitality, and timeless heritage.
home.essenceTitle: Why travelers fall in love with Jugol
home.pillar1Text: Over 1,000 years of preserved Islamic and African civilization inside the stone walls.
home.pillar2Text: Night hyena feeding and sacred three-round coffee rituals still shape the city’s evenings.
home.pillar3Text: A proud City of Peace where diverse faiths and peoples live in harmony.

home.adviceGetHereText: Fly into Dire Dawa, then a scenic drive up to Harar — or come by road and rail via the eastern corridor.
home.adviceDressText: Cover shoulders and knees around shrines and mosques; ask before photographing people.
home.adviceWalkText: Inside the walls, the city is almost entirely pedestrian. Outside, blue bajajs fill the gaps.

about.title: About Visit Harar
about.body1: Visit Harar is the official digital gateway to Harar Jugol — the UNESCO World Heritage fortified historic town in eastern Ethiopia.
about.body2: Harar is known as a fourth holy city of Islam, with about 82 mosques and 102 shrines inside walls roughly 3.3 km long. The historic core covers about 48 hectares on a highland plateau near 1,885 m.
about.body3: This site helps travelers explore gates, markets, faith sites, museums, and living Harari hospitality with verified, respectful guidance. Contact details in the sidebar come from Site settings; fees and opening hours are confirmed locally.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How this government website collects, stores, and protects information.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information this website collects, how it is stored, and how it is used.
privacy.collectBody: We collect only what is needed to run the public website and the content management system.
privacy.collectCookies: Cookies: language preference (lang), session authentication for CMS staff, and a CSRF token for form safety.
privacy.collectAccounts: CMS accounts: name, email, role, and password hash for authorised editors and administrators.
privacy.collectLogs: Technical logs: IP address and user agent may be stored with CMS sessions for security auditing.
privacy.storageBody: Data is stored in the institution's database. Session tokens are stored as hashes. Access to the CMS requires a signed-in staff account.
privacy.phonesBody: The office phone number shown on the site is a public contact detail for the institution. This platform does not maintain a database of citizens' mobile phone numbers.
privacy.rightsBody: For privacy questions about this website, contact the office using the published contact channels.
